local_review.finding_body: The original replacement guidance called spring-modulith-starter-core:2.1.0 class-bearing, but its published JAR has no class files. The starter-jpa marker is valid: that artifact also has no class files.
local_review.finding_title: Replacement guidance names another starter without classes
local_review.fix_note: Merged current master and removed spring-modulith-starter-core from both the marker and descriptor replacement guidance. All four remaining replacement artifacts were verified to contain classes. The PR body is regenerated from this corrected descriptor. The shared publication bug remains tracked separately in #10775.
local_review.review_comment: Approved after the manual repair. The target starter JAR contains zero JVM classes, and all four replacement artifacts contain classes. The contribution remains limited to its artifact index, publication descriptor, and original findings record. Local validateIndexFiles for org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-starter-jpa and validateLibraryStats passed on the tree updated with current master. Native-execution and coverage gates do not apply to this marker-only contribution.

render.reason: The published JAR for org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-starter-jpa:2.1.0 contains only META-INF files (MANIFEST.MF, LICENSE, NOTICE, maven pom/properties) and no JVM class files; it is a dependency-aggregating starter POM whose runtime classes are supplied entirely by its dependencies.
render.replacement: Use class-bearing dependencies such as org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-jpa:2.1.0, org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-core:2.1.0, org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-jackson:2.1.0, and org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-api:2.1.0.
